result.reason: The redline adds Affiliate and contractor coverage and attempts an M&A successor-transfer right, but it does not include the preferred protections making paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. The transfer exception is also undermined by the following sentence declaring any assignment without consent void and by the existing Change of Control carve-out, so it does not reliably achieve even the fallback successor-transfer position. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the Field of Use, payment condition, and unrelated restrictions, but subsection (e) is grammatically imprecise because Affiliates and contractors are not necessarily “individuals.”
